constraints: Run GPU engines sequentially with no conversion or other GPU campaign overlapping.
Each process is capped at 240 seconds. Allocator budgets are 3 GiB, not OS-enforced total process memory limits.
Source and converted model bytes stay in ignored .cache; retained manifests, input IDs, scripts, policies and source hashes define this evidence.
Runner overwrites local result JSON; retain existing evidence before rerunning.
